crossRefs.note: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we…
because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

people.name: Thessalonica
people.line: Macedonian city, site of an early Christian church

translations.web: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
translations.bsb: For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.
translations.kjv: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
translations.asv: for even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my need.
